description: ODC: PostgreSQL rules decided by the type of an attribute of the BASE. {WfCovTask}.[IsDone] is Boolean and is compared with 1 (the SQL Server bit accepted it; PostgreSQL has no boolean = integer) and {WfCovTask}.[Title] is Text added with '+' (PostgreSQL concatenates with || or CONCAT). The job alone does not know the types: the preflight leaves the names in unresolvedSql and the CheckBase refuses against the loaded base, before the first mutation. Runs in OdcJobTests.JobFailsWithTheTeachingMessageInTheOdcLane.
